		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.OPT_CFORMAT", "value"));
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.DEP_VAR", "value"));
			if (!(text == "TABLE"))
			{
				if (text == "POLY")

					switch (text2)

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab)
			{
				bool flag = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) == ModifierKeys.Shift;
				MMOptionGroup val = null;
				if ((((UIElement)(object)MMSpinBox1).IsKeyboardFocused || ((UIElement)(object)MMSpinBox1).IsKeyboardFocusWithin) && !flag)
				{
					if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup1).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup1;
					}
					else if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup3).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup3;
					}
				}
				else if (((UIElement)(object)MMOptionGroup1).IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !flag)
				{
					if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup3).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup3;
					}
				}
				else if (((UIElement)(object)MMFrame2).IsKeyboardFocusWithin && flag && !((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup4).IsMMEnabled && !((AesControlBase)MMFrame1).IsMMEnabled)
				{
					if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup3).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup3;
					}
					else if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup1).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup1;
					}
				}
				else if (((UIElement)(object)MMOptionGroup4).IsKeyboardFocusWithin && flag && !((AesControlBase)MMFrame1).IsMMEnabled)
				{
					if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup3).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup3;
					}
					else if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup1).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup1;
					}
				}
				else if (((UIElement)(object)MMFrame1).IsKeyboardFocusWithin && flag)
				{
					if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup3).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup3;
					}
					else if (((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup1).IsMMEnabled)
					{
						val = MMOptionGroup1;
					}
				}
				else if (((UIElement)(object)MMOptionGroup3).IsKeyboardFocusWithin && flag && ((AesControlBase)MMOptionGroup1).IsMMEnabled)
				{
					val = MMOptionGroup1;
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					foreach (MMOptionButton optionButton in val.OptionButtons)
					{
						if (((ToggleButton)(object)optionButton).IsChecked.HasValue && ((ToggleButton)(object)optionButton).IsChecked.Value)
						{
							flag2 = true;

						}

					}
				}
			}
			((MMTabPage)this).OnPreviewKeyDown(e);

		private void OnDeleteShaftSpeed(object pParameter)
		{
			List<string> list = ((pParameter != null) ? new Collection<string> { pParameter as string }.ToList() : GetSelectedIds(CurveSpeed_GridData).ToList());
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SHAFT_SPEED", "child_ids")) != null && list != null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).NotifyUpdates = false;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.SuspendNotifications();
				DeleteShaftSpeedChildren(list, askForConfirmation: true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).NotifyUpdates = true;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.ResumeNotifications();
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
			}
		}

		private void OnDeleteMachNo(object pParameter)
		{
			List<string> list = ((pParameter != null) ? new Collection<string> { pParameter as string }.ToList() : GetSelectedIds(MachNo_GridData).ToList());
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SHAFT_SPEED", "child_ids")) != null && list != null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).NotifyUpdates = false;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.SuspendNotifications();
				DeleteShaftSpeedChildren(list, askForConfirmation: true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).NotifyUpdates = true;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.ResumeNotifications();
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
				((MMViewModel)this).UpdateAll();
			}
		}

		private void DeleteShaftSpeedChildren(IEnumerable<string> ids, bool askForConfirmation = false)
		{
			Collection<string> source = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SHAFT_SPEED", "child_ids"));
			IList<string> deletedIds = ((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.SHAFT_SPEED"), ids, !askForConfirmation);
			if (deletedIds == null || deletedIds.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.MACH_NO"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.HEAD_DATA"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.POWER_DATA"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.HEADC_DATA"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.PRES_DATA"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.PRATIO_DATA"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.DELP_DATA"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.EFF_DATA"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.EFF_POLY"), (IEnumerable<string>)deletedIds, true);
			List<string> list = (from r in source
				select (r) into a
				where !deletedIds.Contains(a)
				select a).ToList();
			for (int num = 1; num <= list.Count; num++)
			{
				string text = list[num - 1];
				if (text != num.ToString())
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.EFF_DATA." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.EFF_POLY." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.HEAD_DATA." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POWER_DATA." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.HEADC_DATA." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.PRES_DATA." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.PRATIO_DATA." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.DELP_DATA." + text, "id", (object)num.ToString());
				}
			}
			for (int num2 = 1; num2 <= list.Count; num2++)
			{
				string text2 = list[num2 - 1];
				if (text2 != num2.ToString())
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.MACH_NO." + text2, "id", (object)num2.ToString());
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SHAFT_SPEED." + text2, "id", (object)num2.ToString());
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			UpdateParameters();
			UpdateEchoesProperties();
			((CxvViewModel)PerfCurvesScrollAreaVM).UpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
			if (!(pd.Name == "NumberOfCurves_MultiMap") || !(subPropertyName == "Value") || !(NumberOfCurves_MultiMap.Value.ToString() != "MULTIP"))
			{
				return;
			}
			Collection<string> ids = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SHAFT_SPEED", "child_ids"));
			if (ids != null && ids.Count > 1)
			{
				IEnumerable<string> enumerable = from r in ids
					select (r) into r
					where r != ids.First()
					select r;
				if (enumerable != null && enumerable.Count() > 0)
				{
					DeleteShaftSpeedChildren(enumerable);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateParameters()

			if (!(text == "TABLE"))
			{
				if (text == "POLY")

		private void UpdateEchoesProperties()
		{
			if (((CxvStatePropertyData)MachNo_state).IsVisible == true)
			{
				EchoVariablePath = "CurrentSelectedMachNo";
				EchoLabel = ApwnResources.MMcompr_perfcu_data_MMFLabel3;
				EchoUnits = "";
			}
			else if (((CxvStatePropertyData)CurveSpeed_state).IsVisible == true)
			{
				EchoVariablePath = "CurrentSelectedShaftSpeed";
				EchoLabel = ApwnResources.MMcompr_perfcu_data_MMFLabel5;
				EchoUnits = ShaftSpeedUnits.Units;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds(CxvVectorPropertyData gridData)
		{
			if (SelectedRowIndexes == null || gridData == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
			{
				if (selectedRowIndex >= 0 && selectedRowIndex < gridData.Count)
				{
					if (gridData[selectedRowIndex] is CurveSpeedScrollAreaViewModel curveSpeedScrollAreaViewModel)
					{
						yield return curveSpeedScrollAreaViewModel.Id;
					}
					else if (gridData[selectedRowIndex] is MachNoScrollAreaViewModel machNoScrollAreaViewModel)
					{
						yield return machNoScrollAreaViewModel.Id;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddChildrenToPath(string relativePath, Collection<string> ids)
		{
			Collection<string> idsAlreadyCreated = CxsConverter.ValueToStringCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(relativePath, "child_ids"));
			List<string> list = ids.Where((string r) => !idsAlreadyCreated.Any((string a) => a.Equals(r)))?.ToList();
			if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).AddChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(relativePath), (IEnumerable<string>)list);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.REG1_CTYPE", "value");
			object obj2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Output.REG2_CTYPE", "value");
			if (obj == null || obj == DBNull.Value || obj2 == null || obj2 == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = (int)obj;
			int num2 = (int)obj2;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				switch (num)
				{
				case 1:
					FrmReg1Poly1Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Head_curve;
					break;
				case 2:
					FrmReg1Poly1Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Head_coefficient_curve;
					break;
				case 3:
					FrmReg1Poly1Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Power_curve;
					break;
				case 4:
					FrmReg1Poly1Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Discharge_pressure_curve;
					break;
				case 5:
					FrmReg1Poly1Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Pressure_ratio_curve;
					break;
				case 6:
					FrmReg1Poly1Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Pressure_change_curve;
					break;
				default:
					FrmReg1Poly1Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Head_curve;
					break;
				}
				if (num2 == 3)
				{
					FrmReg1Poly2Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Power_curve;
				}
				else
				{
					FrmReg1Poly2Caption = Resources.MMcompr_Results_Regres_ViewModel_Efficiency_curve;
				}
			}
		}
